title: Nosey skills manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: Structural contract for skills-manifest.json. This schema is not a registry validator: parser-only rules (uniqueness by property, path normalization, UTF-16 regex limits, external source shape) and registry-level integration rules (registryId agreement, skill file existence, dangling references, external identity conflicts) are listed instead of encoded.

$schema.title: Editor annotation
$schema.description: Conventional editor annotation only. Nosey ignores it, registry writers preserve it verbatim, and it is unconstrained here: a non-string value is accepted too.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Only 1 is accepted.

registryId.title: Registry ID
registryId.description: Identity shared with registry.json and skills-map.json. The owner/repository shape is an initializer authoring rule, not a parser rule.
registryId.x-normalization: Rewritten by registry init, which remaps this prefix in local skill IDs.

skills.title: Skill records
skills.description: Every locally declared skill. Duplicate ids or paths are rejected by the parser only.

Text.title: Nonblank string
Text.description: The parser's text() rule: a string containing at least one non-whitespace character. Empty strings, whitespace-only strings, and non-strings are rejected. The pattern matches exactly the characters trim() removes, including U+00A0, U+1680, U+2028, U+202F, and U+FEFF.

NonEmptyArrayItem.title: Nonempty array element
NonEmptyArrayItem.description: The parser's strings() rule for reference arrays: every element is a string of at least one character. Unlike text(), whitespace-only elements pass. Duplicates are accepted here.

LocalSkillId.title: Local skill ID
LocalSkillId.description: A locally declared skill ID is <registryId>/<relative directory under skills>, for example acme/skills/group/example. Nested folders are supported, so no segment count is enforced; the external three-segment ID rule does not apply.
LocalSkillId.x-normalization: Generated as <registryId>/<relative directory under skills>; init remaps the registryId prefix and leaves external IDs untouched.

SkillPath.title: Skill path
SkillPath.description: Repository-relative path ending in /SKILL.md with no backslash. Absolute paths, NUL, unnormalized paths (repeated separators, trailing slash), and dot segments are rejected by the parser only.

SkillRecord.title: Skill record
SkillRecord.description: One locally declared skill. Unknown keys inside a record are ignored by the parser.

id.title: Skill ID
id.description: Unique among manifest skills; duplicates are rejected by the parser only.

path.title: Skill path
path.description: Unique among manifest skills; duplicates are rejected by the parser only. The file must exist and stay inside the registry (integration rule).

description.title: Skill description
description.description: Optional. When present it must pass text(), so null and whitespace-only values are rejected.
